rows.Description: Creates a signed URL to an object in an OSS bucket.
The signed S3 URL to download the .rvt file.

codeExamples.raw:
curl -X GET \
      'https://developer.api.autodesk.com/oss/v2/buckets/<YOUR_BUCKET_KEY>/objects/<RESULT_FILE_OBJECT_KEY>/signeds3download'
      - H 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN>' \
      - H 'Content-Type: application/json'
